title: US single release: Beaucoups Of Blues by Ringo Starr | 1970
content:
Ringo Starr’s ‘Beaucoups of Blues’ single was released in the USA on 5 October 1970.

The single peaked at number 87 on the Billboard chart. It was also released in Australia, Canada, and Germany, but fared only slightly better.

It was the only single released from the album of the same name. Its b-side was the non-album session outtake ‘Coochy Coochy’, written by Starr.

‘Beaucoups Of Blues’ later appeared on Starr’s greatest hits collections Blast from Your Past and Photograph: The Very Best Of Ringo Starr.
